# noderings_roles (Data Source)

Lists every role in the organization, built-in and custom.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_roles" "all" {}

output "custom_roles" {
  value = [for r in data.noderings_roles.all.roles : r.name if !r.builtin]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in role.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `permission_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the permissions the role grants.
